# <b>NOTICE OF CONVENING OF
EARLY VOTING BALLOT BOARD</b>

<b>To: Early Voting Clerk and Custodian of Ballot Box Key</b>

<b>The Early Voting Ballot Board will convene on Friday, June 4, 2021 at 1pm, for the purpose
of qualifying the early voting ballots cast in the election held on Saturday, June 5, 2021. The
board will meet at 204 E Jefferson Street Waxahachie, TX 75165.</b>

<b>You are hereby instructed to deliver all election materials, ballots voted by mail, locked
ballot box(es), and the keys to the ballot box(es) to me at the time designated above.</b>

<signature/>
<b>Presiding Judge
Early Voting Ballot Board</b>

5-26-21
<b>Date</b>
